article.body:
Kintsugi-VLA: Supplied Record Identifies a Recovery-Data Method, Not a Robot Demonstration

Kintsugi-VLA is an arXiv research method for turning failed robot rollouts into recovery data through “interventional recoverability,” published on 28 September 2026; the supplied record identifies no specific task or environment. No robot embodiment, joint count, degrees of freedom, gripper, payload, reach or precision is provided.
